title: Examining the effect of manganese distribution on alcohol production in CoMn/TiO2 FTS catalysts
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00746H, Paper
Open Access

Jay M. Pritchard, Matthew Lindley, Danial Farooq, Urvashi Vyas, Sarah J. Haigh, James Paterson, Mark Peacock, Andrew M. Beale
A comparison of the effect of the preparation methods for CoMn/TiO2 Fischer–Tropsch synthesis catalysts reveals the prevalence of Mn surface doping leading to enhanced product selectivity towards olefins and alcohols.
